api_assume_role_arn.description: The ARN of the role to assume when calling the KMS API to create a JWT signature.

api_base_url.description: The base URL for where the Happy API is located.

api_kms_key_id.description: If set, the provider will use the KMS key ID to sign the JWT for the happy service user. The provider will need valid AWS credentials via an assume role (set in api_assume_role_arn) with access to the key.

api_oidc_authz_id.description: The Okta authorization server ID that authenticates the requests to the Happy API.

api_oidc_issuer.description: The OIDC issuer value that corresponds to the client ID of the Okta application associated with the private key.

api_oidc_scope.description: The required scope for the service account to authenticate properly.

api_private_key.description: The authentication credentials in the form of a PEM encoded private key to authenticate to the Happy API.

api_region.description: The AWS region to use when calling KMS.

app_configs.description: Array of config keys and values

app_name.description: The name of the app to fetch configs for

environment.description: The app environment to fetch configs for

stack.description: The name of the stack to fetch configs for

app_name.description: The name of the app to fetch configs for

aws_profile.description: The AWS profile where the app/env is deployed

aws_region.description: The AWS region where the app/env is deployed

k8s_cluster_id.description: The k8s cluster ID where the app/env is deployed

k8s_namespace.description: The k8s namespace where the app/env is deployed

stacklist.description: Array of stack names for the given env

task_launch_type.description: 'fargate' or 'k8s', depending where the app/env is deployed
